body.heading: Free money
paragraphs: Money must circulate. In the tradition of Silvio Gesell, money that is hoarded strangles the exchange it is supposed to serve — so money should carry a cost for standing still, and work should not.
When money moves, the free market works for everyone.

body.heading: Free land
paragraphs: The Earth is the commons of all. Nobody can honestly claim it as property to be bought and sold forever. What is private is the improvement, not the ground.
Ground rent belongs to society; labour belongs to the labourer.

body.heading: Free market, free people, free software
paragraphs: The same law holds everywhere: goods, code and ideas must be free to circulate. Software that cannot be forked is money that cannot move.
When in doubt, use brute force — and share the source.
